sources.title: Prometheus Research Foundation
sources.usage: Canonical Research entrypoint for foundation, briefing-system, source-policy, and handoff references.
sources.limitations: Internal architecture source; not external market evidence.

sources.title: Market Intelligence Engine v1
sources.usage: Research-owned architecture for market opportunity scoring, industry attractiveness, outside-sales market ranking, and expansion recommendations.
sources.limitations: Architecture-only source; current market scores require attributable external evidence before founder-ready recommendations.

sources.title: Customer Intelligence Graph
sources.usage: Internal Intelligence Engine architecture that defines customer-specific graph boundaries and future Research consumer constraints.
sources.limitations: Architecture-only source; Research must not consume runtime graph data without approved Intelligence handoff.

sources.title: Adaptive Outside Sales Intelligence Engine
sources.usage: Internal Intelligence Engine architecture that defines how approved Research context may become future contextual evidence.
sources.limitations: Architecture-only source; does not authorize production integration.

sources.title: Prometheus Competitor Research
sources.usage: Existing competitive-positioning baseline to prevent duplicate research documents.
sources.limitations: External competitor facts should be refreshed from primary sources before public use.

sources.title: Competitor Pricing And Revenue Snapshot
sources.usage: Existing pricing and revenue baseline to reuse during future competitor refreshes.
sources.limitations: Private-company revenue estimates are directional, not audited facts.

sources.title: USPTO Patent Public Search
sources.publisher: United States Patent and Trademark Office
sources.usage: Patent activity checks for route optimization, field sales AI, territory intelligence, and related claims.
sources.limitations: Patent interpretation requires qualified legal review.

sources.title: SEC EDGAR
sources.usage: Funding, public-company filings, risk factors, and market signals.
sources.limitations: Many direct competitors are private and may not appear in EDGAR.

sources.title: Federal Register
sources.usage: Regulatory monitoring for employment, telecommunications, healthcare, privacy, and field-sales compliance.
sources.limitations: Regulatory impact should be reviewed with qualified counsel.

sources.title: OpenAI Documentation
sources.usage: AI product capability and integration research from official documentation.
sources.limitations: Documentation changes frequently and should be checked before implementation recommendations.
